items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: much more than the $100 that Joseph was paying me

ctx.x: But Josephs didn't feel like he was getting his money's worth -- because we worked eight hours a night, plus we come in there after hours to rehearse. But I just refused to do it, see.

So then he was supposed to have fired me or something -- I forget what just happened. But coupled right with that, I got an offer to go back with Goodman to do his show, Seven Lively Arts. And that paid very well, certainly much more than the $100 that Joseph was paying me.
I think Cozy did that with you, didn't he? Cozy Cole?
